欢迎来到我们的cod退伍计划~
本计划主要关注cod老兵福祉，给他们一个平静而愉悦的退伍生活。
（如果能够顺带解决个人问题就更好了🤣）
如果您有什么意见或建议或者BUG询问可以通过邮箱联系我：wqshdx@foxmail.com
QQ群：560752879

Welcome to our cod retirement program~!
This program focuses on the well-being of cod veterans, giving them a peaceful and enjoyable retirement.
(It would be nice if the players can solve their marital problems by the way LOL)
If you have any opinions, suggestions or bug inquiries, you can contact me via email:
wqshdx@foxmail.com

[b][size=4]🎇2.0版本新增内容！🎇
🎇New content added in version 2.0!🎇[/size]
[/b]
[b]✨新增可结婚对象：[u]Ghost。[/u][/b]
[b]✨新增地图：[/b]Ghost的农场与小屋（可耕种与钓鱼）
※需要秋季解锁，Ghost相关剧情，打招呼之后需要等待一天收到道路解锁的邮件即可进入。
[b]✨新增剧情：[/b]Ghost好感度剧情
※4♥，6♥与8♥剧情会使Ghost的农场和小屋地图产生变化
※※Ghost与Keegan一样，10♥剧情有他们的求婚情节，在该剧情前后赠送美人鱼吊坠会有对话内容差分，如果对此有兴趣可以不急着刷满好感立刻求婚。
[b]✨新增功能：[/b]与Ghost拥有一定好感度之后，可以在他的农场种地和过夜，需要通过前置剧情。

[b]✨ New marriage partner:[/b] Ghost.
[b]✨ New map: [/b]Ghost's farm and cottage (for farming and fishing)
※ Need to unlock in autumn, Ghost related storyline. After saying hello, you need to wait for one day to receive the road unlock email to enter.
[b]✨ New storyline: [/b]Ghost favorability storyline
※4 ♥，6 ♥ With 8 ♥ ；The plot will cause changes to Ghost's farm and cabin maps
※※Ghost, like Keegan, is 10 ♥ The plot has their proposal plot, and giving a mermaid pendant before and after the plot will result in a difference in dialogue content. If you are interested in this, you can immediately propose without rushing to fill your impression.
[b]✨ New feature: [/b]After gaining a certain level of affinity with Ghost, you can farm and spend the night on his farm, which requires a pre story plot.
